respuesta.pregunta: For catalog-portfolio-api, did the architecture diagram change between 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a and latest? I want to know if any components or external services were added or removed.
respuesta.respuesta:
No. The architecture diagram is identical in 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a and latest. Neither version adds or removes a component, connection or external service [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L31-L60] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L31-L60].

Both versions show the same diagram:

- **Request path:** Client Applications go through a Load Balancer to the Catalog Portfolio API [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L32-L33] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L32-L33].
- **Layers:** the API passes requests through the Controllers, Service and DAO layers down to a MySQL database [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L35-L38] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L35-L38].
- **External services:** the Service layer connects to the Pictures API, the Regulations API and BigQuery Events [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L40-L42] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L40-L42].
- **Metrics:** the API sends data to Metrics Collection, which feeds a DataDog Dashboard [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L44-L45] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L44-L45].
- **Per-domain parts:** each of the Controller, Service and DAO layers has a Brand, Logo, Collector and Resource component [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L47-L60] [catalog-portfolio-api/latest/guide/architecture/README.md:L47-L60].
